key_reasoning.reason: Four production components across three subsystems: guardrail_service (service layer), workflow router (API layer), dependecies.py (core/infrastructure), and llm_factory.py (enterprise/LiteLLM) — the latter two touched for Sonar cognitive-complexity and duplicated-literal fixes alongside the primary guardrail dry-run work.

Core change is an authorization enforcement fix: sync_guardrail_assignments_for_entity now runs with dry_run=True as a pre-persist gate on PUT /workflows/{id} and POST /workflows/{id}/validate, preventing DB writes when guardrail permission checks fail. Authz red flag applied (bump M→L). The dry_run pattern had no pre-existing template in the codebase — new control path.
